resources.string: Lets you control the screen by voice (back, scroll, tap, screenshots).

Sami is a personal voice assistant, not a disability tool. When you enable this, Sami can perform the screen actions you ask for by voice — go back, open recents or notifications, take a screenshot, scroll, and tap or long-press items by their name. Sami reads the current window only when you give a screen command; it does not monitor, store, or upload what is on your screen.
